summary: Completed comprehensive testing of new Display Settings functionality for hotel lobby TV screen. All display orientation and scale features are working perfectly with proper backend API integration and frontend UI implementation.
passed_tests: Backend API supports display_orientation and display_scale settings
PUT /api/settings successfully updates display orientation and scale values
Admin panel Display Settings card displays correctly with Monitor icon
Landscape orientation button shows 16:9 icon and 'Landscape' text
Portrait orientation button shows 9:16 icon and 'Portrait' text
Display Scale slider works correctly with range 50% to 150%
Preview box shows current orientation (16:9 for landscape, 9:16 for portrait)
Preview box updates immediately when orientation changes
Settings save correctly with success message 'Settings saved successfully'
Lobby display applies landscape orientation correctly (no rotation)
Lobby display applies portrait orientation correctly (90-degree rotation)
Lobby display applies scale setting correctly (transform: scale())
Portrait mode shows rotated content with .rotate-90 class applied
Landscape mode shows normal content without rotation
Scale transforms are applied correctly (matrix(1.25, 0, 0, 1.25, 0, 0) for 125%)
All display content (hotel name, clock, weather) renders correctly in both orientations
Slide transitions work properly with applied orientation and scale settings
